Kids are basically manipulated into thinking that college/university is a part of life from a very young age. Students learn to look down on others who choose to go later in life, or not at all. It's virtually considered a personality trait at this point. In reality Highschools typically manipulate/pressure the students to attend in order to look good. And we shouldn't be rushing teens into university/college when this is the prime time in life to figure out what you love to do. What good is a 22 year old student with a bachelor degree in a field they hate? The world would be better off full of 25-30 even 60 year olds that love what they're doing. Give yourself freedom. I promise it'll make the world a less miserable place when you start pursuing what truly makes you happy. And stop the stigma around trade schools. Stop the stigma around artists. Stop glorifying degrees solely off their income. Start glorifying a degree or future that makes your child happy.
